title: Juicy Tunisian Filo Pastry Pie
description: This Juicy Tunisian Filo Pastry Pie is a crowd-pleaser featuring tender filo pastry filled with a savory and juicy mixture that's easy to make, kosher-friendly, and perfect for breakfast or a light meal.

ingredients.name: 3 cloves garlic, minced
ingredients.notes: adjust quantity if using fresh garlic or less potent garlic variety

ingredients.name: 1 red bell pepper, roasted and peeled
ingredients.notes: ensure it's thoroughly cooked to a crispy texture for optimal flavor

ingredients.name: 1/2 cup heavy cream (skimmed)
ingredients.notes: adjust if using full-fat cream for lower fat content

ingredients.name: 1 tsp lemon juice
ingredients.notes: ensure it's fresh and does not have any preservatives

ingredients.name: Salt to taste
ingredients.notes: use kosher salt or regular table salt

ingredients.name: Fresh parsley, chopped (optional)
ingredients.notes: to garnish the top of the pie

instructions: Place phyllo sheets on a clean surface and cover with a damp cloth.
Mix minced garlic, roasted red bell pepper, heavy cream, lemon juice, and salt in a bowl. Set aside.
Carefully unfold a sheet of phyllo dough and place it on a flat serving plate.
Spread half of the filling mixture evenly over the phyllo, leaving about 1 inch (2.5 cm) around the edges for sealing.
Gently fold one corner of the phyllo over the filling, then roll up from that corner toward the center, tucking the ends underneath as you go.
Repeat with remaining sheets of phyllo and filling mixture to make two pie-like layers.
Brush the top layer lightly with olive oil (if using) for added flavor and easier flipping during baking.
Place both layers into a greased 9-inch pie dish, ensuring they are sealed tightly at the edges.
Bake in preheated oven for about 25-30 minutes or until golden brown. Check occasionally to prevent burning.
Let it rest for a few minutes before serving with fresh parsley on top if desired.
